dedupe_keys.name: b5g network slicing scenarios and packet level performance benchmarks

description: This dataset pairs synthetic network-slicing configurations with packet-level performance metrics for 5G and beyond. Universitat de Girona and Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya researchers vary topology, traffic, routes and slice instances for enhanced mobile broadband, ultra-reliable low-latency communications and massive IoT. Each sample links a scenario to per-flow delay, jitter and loss. Zenodo provides a simulation archive, Python data-access script and feature documentation free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is transport-network infrastructure; the radio access network is explicitly excluded. A custom admission-control module shapes the generated scenarios, which is a limitation when comparing other service-level policies. No calendar observation period applies. A reviewer-assessed use is fitting performance surrogates or testing resource-allocation assumptions in network planning simulations. platform-ns-3 is a related packet simulator, without verified scenario compatibility. No archive, API script or trained model was downloaded or executed.
